notes.q1_coverage_method: Denominator = non-test source files under src/ (find src -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) ! -name '*.test.ts' ! -name '*.test.tsx' | wc -l = 177). Coverage = 59/177 = 33.3%. Prior denominators (118, 160) had no recorded command and were not reproducible; this definition replaces them and is recomputed from files each cycle. File-level coverage >=80% is mathematically unreachable under the 80-term budget cap (would require ~142 terms); the consolidation policy (129->59) deliberately trades file-count coverage for concept-level coverage of domain entities/services/architecture, per the bloat-control principle (prefer consolidation over growth).
